versions.changelog: v1.1.0 核心升级：财务比率从 9 项扩展为 4 类 18 项（偿债 7 / 营运效率 3 / 盈利 5 / 发展 3），支持现金流量表与上期数据，自动计算平均余额与增长率；清理硬编码路径；新增 version 元数据；README 与 License 同步更新。完全向后兼容。

Enterprise Report Merger 1.0.0 — initial release

- Supports merging multiple enterprise reports (Excel/PDF/images) using three built-in strategies: vertical stacking, keyword mapping, and consolidation with elimination entries.
- Fills merged data into Word (.docx) templates to generate professional reports.
- Offers on-demand full analysis report generation (e.g., post-loan analysis) when users explicitly request it and no template is provided.
- Automatically detects and warns users about image-based PDFs for manual validation or assisted recognition.
- Only triggers advanced features such as automatic analysis reports if the user requests; default action is merging and/or template filling.
